page.layout: Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Below it, one full-width block: the dedication title in italic, set in several centred lines. Then the salutation "Salutem à Domino!" and the greeting "Vir Excellentissime,", both as separate lines. Below them one column of body text in one paragraph, with the catchword "brevi" at the right under the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Viro admodum Reverendo, Excellentissimo, & Dignissimo D. Simeoni de Muis, Sacrarum Hebraearumque Literarum apud Parisienses Professori Regio Celeberrimo, Insignis Ecclesiae Suesfionensis Canonico & Archidiacono, Domino plurimum honorando.
main_text.p: Miraberis forte, unde haec audacia, quod homo tibi ignotus, nulloque litterarum commercio familiaris, occupatissimum te & ad maxima quaeque natum insulsa & rudi Epistola detinere atque compellare ausim. Sed desine mirari: humanitas tua aliis probata, egregia eruditio, conspicua literarum monu-menta, & si quae sunt alia, quae in te emicant; faces porrò, quas ad tale quid audendum subinde addit Vir Clarissimus mihique amicissimus D. Johannes Buxtorfius, tandemque ὁμοτεχνία[?] & causae quam pari Zelo defendimus, commu-nio, pudoris repagula rumpere, teque

page.notes: Greek word after "tandemque" read as ὁμοτεχνία but the scan is faint; marked [?]. The long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Drop cap M joined to "iraberis". The digitiser banner and scan spots are omitted.
